title: The description
aiStatement: The description is all the AI sees
description: “Use when we reach a new site and need a sample from the seabed.”
analogy: The index is open, every card behind it closed.
agent: SKILL.md: name and description load first

the-label-decides.title: The label decides
the-label-decides.script: We are still in sunlight, and this is the part most people skip. A skill the model never picks helps nobody, so the description matters more than the instructions.

name-description.title: Name, description
name-description.script: Before the model opens a skill, it sees two lines: the name and the description. That is all the index holds, and it is all the model has to decide with.
